## <i class="bi bi-cloud-download ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> Database access

Data originally provided by:

- **Contact:** Scarlett Murphy
- **Email:** [Scarlett.Murphy@usda.gov](mailto:Scarlett.Murphy@usda.gov)
- **Original source:** <https://ncsslabdatamart.sc.egov.usda.gov/>

**Available files**

| Type | Filename | Link |
|------|----------|------|
| MIR spectra — CSV (gzip) | `ossl_mir_v1.3.csv.gz` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/KSSL/ossl_mir_v1.3.csv.gz) |
| MIR spectra — Parquet | `ossl_mir_v1.3.parquet` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/KSSL/ossl_mir_v1.3.parquet) |
| Soil lab measurements — CSV (gzip) | `ossl_soillab_v1.3.csv.gz` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/KSSL/ossl_soillab_v1.3.csv.gz) |
| Soil lab measurements — Parquet | `ossl_soillab_v1.3.parquet` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/KSSL/ossl_soillab_v1.3.parquet) |
| Soil site metadata — CSV (gzip) | `ossl_soilsite_v1.3.csv.gz` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/KSSL/ossl_soilsite_v1.3.csv.gz) |
| Soil site metadata — Parquet | `ossl_soilsite_v1.3.parquet` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/KSSL/ossl_soilsite_v1.3.parquet) |
| VisNIR spectra — CSV (gzip) | `ossl_visnir_v1.3.csv.gz` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/KSSL/ossl_visnir_v1.3.csv.gz) |
| VisNIR spectra — Parquet | `ossl_visnir_v1.3.parquet` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/KSSL/ossl_visnir_v1.3.parquet) |


## <i class="bi bi-geo-alt ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> Map

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/soilspectroscopy/ossl-imports/main/dataset/KSSL/README_files/figure-commonmark/map-1.png)

## <i class="bi bi-pin-map ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> Soil site information

- **Coordinates precision:** precise, county, country
- **Sampling depth:** various
- **Geography:** soil taxonomy, soil horizon
- **Variables available (OSSL):** 14 out of 14 — see [Database description](../db-desc.html#panel-soilsite) for full schema
- **Populated columns:** `id.layer_local_c`, `id.layer_uuid_txt`, `id.dataset.site_ascii_txt`, `layer.upper.depth_usda_cm`, `layer.lower.depth_usda_cm`, `layer.texture_usda_txt`, `pedon.taxa_usda_txt`, `horizon.designation_usda_txt`, `observation.date.begin_iso.8601_yyyy.mm.dd`, `observation.date.end_iso.8601_yyyy.mm.dd`, `longitude.point_wgs84_dd`, `latitude.point_wgs84_dd`, `longitude.county_wgs84_dd`, `latitude.county_wgs84_dd`

## <i class="bi bi-clipboard-data ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> Soil laboratory information

- **Total samples:** 64,667
- **Properties available (original):** 1000+
- **Properties standardized (OSSL):** 51 — summarized in **@tbl-soillab-kssl** below
- **Categories:** physical, chemical, biological, hydrological, carbon & nutrients, metal elements
- **Original source:** see [Database access](#database-access)

## <i class="bi bi-soundwave ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> MIR

- **Acquisition mode:** DRIFT
- **Intensity:** absorbance
- **Original range:** 400-4000
- **Standardized range:** 600-4000
- **Instrument:** Vertex 70 FT-IR
- **Manufacturer:** Bruker Optics
- **Scan accessory:** HTS-XT
- **Sample preparation:** Air-dried, finely ground < 80mesh
- **Additional info:** MCT (mercury cadmium telluride) detector

### MIR plot

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/soilspectroscopy/ossl-imports/main/dataset/KSSL/README_files/figure-commonmark/mir_plot-1.png)

## <i class="bi bi-soundwave ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> VNIR

- **Acquisition mode:** Diffuse Reflectance
- **Intensity:** reflectance
- **Original range:** 350-2500
- **Instrument:** ASD Labspec 2500
- **Manufacturer:** Analytical Spectral Devices Inc., PANalytical NIR Excellence Center
- **Instrument co-scans:** Not available
- **Scan repeats:** 1
- **Scan accessory:** ASD's MugLite accessory
- **Original resolution:** Not available
- **Sample preparation:** Air-dried, Sieved < 2 mm
- **Additional info:** A standard Spectralon panel was used to obtain the white reference at 15-min intervals.
